newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain wants to consolidate historic inflation low.
newsitem.headline: Spain wants to consolidate historic inflation low.

text.p: Spain's Economy Ministry said on Friday the sharp reduction in the consumer price index rate, which was 1.5 percent year-on-year in May versus 1.7 percent in April, now needed to consolidate.

"The important thing now is to consolidate the historic lows we have reached, and that will allow the Spanish economy to compete in good condition when it is part of Europe's single currency," a statement said.
It added that for that to be achieved everybody must adapt to the new low inflation environment, paying particular attention to the fixing of prices and wages.
